sources.title: Rosa's Encouragement — Perfect Order 114 official card page
sources.verification: The official card text restricts use to when its player has more Prize cards remaining than the opponent.
sources.supportsZh: 作为“己方与对方剩余奖赏卡比较”通用条件的卡文建模用例；不表示该真实卡已完成整卡审核或已启用。

sources.title: Garchomp — Unified Minds 114 official card page
sources.verification: The official card text has an attack-damage condition based on having more Prize cards remaining than the opponent.
sources.supportsZh: 作为相对奖赏条件可用于持续伤害修正和攻击程序的用例；不表示该真实卡已经通过完整规则、合法性和资料审核。

sources.title: Play! Pokémon Competitive Pokémon Rules and Formats
sources.verification: The official index provides the maintained entry points for rulebooks, tournament rules, legality notices and errata.
sources.supportsZh: 用于规则包与卡文持续核验；索引页本身不被当作相对奖赏条件的完整逐项裁定。

retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior or log is used as rule authority.
No Japanese, Asian, Pocket or community source is mixed into the international ruleset.
Every real card remains unavailable until its full official text, timing and legality are audited.
implementationLimits: Supports player-zone BENCH_COUNT, HAND_SIZE, PRIZE_COUNT and DISCARD_COUNT conditions with compare_to=OPPONENT, all computed by the server.
Supports a second explicitly public compare_target for numeric conditions; hidden zones, client-selected targets and ambiguous value-plus-target data reject before resolution.
This is a reusable condition component only. It does not itself implement Rosa's Encouragement, Garchomp, Counter Gain, Reversal Energy, Rule Box restrictions or multi-host Energy allocation.
